svg.title: Two position IK branches and finite motion along an instantaneous null direction

cc:Work.dc:title: Two position IK branches and finite motion along an instantaneous null direction
cc:Work.dc:description: Fixed unit links, counterclockwise positive joint angles, world x right and y up. Left: two arms reach (1,1) metres. Right: saved finite FK inward displacement versus epsilon, compared with the second-order prediction; a zero first derivative is not global immobility.
